title: Missing custom logic for USDC spot market
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium  **Likelihood:** High  ## Description  When adding a supported asset using addAsset(), the spotMarket ID must be provided. This market ID is later used in getRate() to fetch the USD value of the deposited asset through a precompile call. However, in the case of USDC, there is no valid spot market to get its price:  ``` Universe: [   {'tokens': [1, 0], 'name': 'PURR/USDC', 'index': 0, 'isCanonical': True},   {'tokens': [2, 0], 'name': '@1', 'index': 1, 'isCanonical': False},   {'tokens': [3, 0], 'name': '@2', 'index': 2, 'isCanonical': False} ] ``` All listed tok
